messages:
ellie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — alert noise + paging churn still causing unnecessary oncalls. We need owners for: threshold sweep, dedupe rules, quiet-window, and a smoke-test harness to validate changes. @aditya @kevin can you take?

aditya: Taking threshold sweep. I'll run sensitivity scans (95/99/99.9 percentiles) and propose tuned thresholds by EOD Wed. Will add before/after tokenized metrics to the remediation doc.

kevin: I'll own dedupe rules and paging policy changes. Plan: introduce a probabilistic dedupe (hash traces) and a 10m aggregation window for infra alerts. ETA Fri. I'll post the specific rule diffs here for review.

sara: I'll build and wire the smoke-test harness to the canary pipeline and automate post-deploy alert simulations. Will run nightly for 7 days after changes and post results.

ellie: Awesome. Also add rollback criteria: missed true positives must stay <1% compared to baseline, and paging rate must drop >=30% before we mark done.

aditya: Added validation steps to the remediation doc: replay last-30-days incidents, compute TP recall delta and paging delta. If recall delta >1%, we abort and revert. :thumbsup:

kevin: Draft change (WIP) — demote noisy alerts from paging to #alerts-slack and add aggregation:

```yaml
- alert: service_disk_io_high
  severity: page
  for: 5m
  labels:
    team: storage
  annotations:
    runbook: /runbooks/disk-io
  # proposed change: move to slack only and increase aggregation
- alert: ephemeral_conn_spike
  severity: slack_only
  aggregation_window: 10m
```

ops-bot: Reminder: canary deploy scheduled 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. Run smoke tests after canary with `/run-smoke-tests --profile alert-remediation`.

sara: I'll hook the harness to the canary and publish nightly runs to the doc at https://notion.so/redwood/alert-remediation-abc123. Will include pass/fail and the infra replay script. ETA for first run: canary completion + 30m.

aditya: Also adding a small tuning matrix: percentile vs threshold vs paging rate so we can pick conservative defaults first, ramp over 3 days.

ellie: I've added owners and milestones to the remediation board (Milestone: reduce-night-paging-2026-03-29). Please keep updates short here when you make progress. We'll review the canary smoke results in next week's ops sync.

kevin: Putting the rule diff in this thread when ready. Quick ask: who owns the follow-up postmortem note update? I can do the rule rationale section.

ellie: I'll update the postmortem with the action items and link to the board. Thanks everyone.

sara: Will post the first smoke run summary here once it finishes. Good to go from my side.

aditya: Wed EOD for threshold PR, Fri for dedupe PR from Kevin. tagging in case schedule shifts.

ellie: Great. Closing loop: owners = aditya (thresholds), kevin (dedupe/paging), sara (smoke tests), ellie (pm + doc). Next check-in: Mon 09:30 ops sync. :party:
